Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis specifically targeted the IFT140 interactome using Strep-Tactin affinity purification from HEK293 cells. While hTERT-RPE1 cells were used for CRISPR KO and immunofluorescence, the LC-MS/MS data was derived from the affinity-purified complexes from HEK293 cells.
